integrity_notes: Analytic proof is provided in full; finite checker tests are corroborative only. Source theorem and new claim are distinguished. No independent mathematical validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to balanced skew interactions, equal maturation rates, and normalized intra-specific competition. No conclusion for generic random communities, stochastic forcing, delays or unequal stage conversions. Related classic entropy/migration stability theorems could imply aspects; historical priority unvalidated.
title: Uniform global entropy decay under arbitrarily switching stage-antagonistic ecological interactions
